caption: The drawing features a plain beige background with three outlined vessel shapes placed vertically along the left side—the top one is a two-handled pot, the middle and bottom are single-handled jugs. Each vessel is drawn with a thin, blue line and left uncolored. Arranged among these vessels are three stylized birds, each drawn and shaded in blue and gray tones. The uppermost bird, near the top left, is perched above two simple leaves. The central bird is larger, positioned to the right of the center vessel, and depicted perched on a flowing branch with elongated leaves and curling ends. The lowest bird stands to the right of the bottom vessel outline, facing left, also perched on an ornate, curling branch adorned with stylized leaves. All birds are rendered in solid shades of blue, dark gray, and black, with details and highlights in white. The overall composition is symmetrical in layout, alternating between birds and vessels.
title: Bird Decorations on Stoneware Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
